summary: Persist the live-fetched surah metadata in qkLoadSurahMeta so later offline plan commands read it locally.
reason: The generated fallback fetched /surahs to build a plan but never cached it, so a subsequent 'plan today'/'plan status' still saw <114 local rows, refetched, and failed offline.
validated_outcome: After 'plan start' (live), 'plan today --data-source local' returns the correct range (1:1 to 2:201) with no network call.
